intro.fr: C&C Reloaded se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: C&C Reloaded can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Heinki/Reloaded-Randomizer, qui héberge l'APWorld de C&C Reloaded.
text.en: The GitHub repository Heinki/Reloaded-Randomizer, home of the C&C Reloaded APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, V1.0.
text.en: The first version, V1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version V1.8, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (9 versions publiées).
text.en: Version V1.8 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (9 versions released).

text.fr: C&C Reloaded figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: C&C Reloaded is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
